name: Dreadpeak
detailed_description:
In 13th-century Japan, a young warrior rises from tragedy to seek justice. After the ruthless warlord Akamori ambushes the peaceful village of Kurotani, killing the protagonist’s father and its innocent people, only one thing remains: a blood-stained katana. This weapon becomes a symbol of vengeance, honor, and a promise to the fallen.

Dreadpeak is a single-player action-adventure game that blends precision combat with emotional storytelling. Players will experience a cinematic journey of revenge and redemption set in feudal Japan. They will wield a katana in intense close-quarters battles, explore atmospheric environments such as forests, villages, and mountains, and infiltrate Akamori’s heavily guarded fortress. Along the way, they can recruit unique allies with their own backgrounds and abilities. The game features traditional Japanese aesthetics, an original soundtrack, and fully voice-acted cutscenes that immerse the player in a world shaped by loss, loyalty, and the fight to reclaim lost honor.

Will you restore your honor and bring peace to a land consumed by darkness?
